## Thesis

::: {.pub-entry}
<div class="pub-title">Projeto de Classificadores de Padrões Baseados em Protótipos Usando Evolução Diferencial</div>
<div class="pub-meta">
Luiz Soares de Andrade Filho · Master's thesis, 2014<br>
Programa de Pós-Graduação em Engenharia de Teleinformática, Universidade Federal do Ceará (UFC)<br>
Concentration area: Signals and Systems · Advisor: Prof. Dr. Guilherme de Alencar Barreto
</div>
<div class="pub-meta">
*English (working translation): "Design of Prototype-Based Pattern Classifiers Using Differential Evolution."*
</div>
<div class="pub-links">
[PDF — UFC Institutional Repository](https://repositorio.ufc.br/bitstream/riufc/12478/1/2014_dis_lsandradefilho.pdf)
</div>
:::

This thesis develops prototype-based pattern classifiers whose prototypes are optimized using differential evolution, a global, population-based optimization method. This work is the origin of my background in computational intelligence, pattern recognition, and optimization methods that now inform my interest in computational and agent-based approaches to economics and public policy.
